claims.sourceText: The Debrief, 'Colm Kelleher: AAWSAP and the Skinwalker Enigma', 25 May 2023
claims.text: Kelleher led the NIDS team on Skinwalker Ranch 1996-2004 and in 2008 became Deputy Administrator of BAASS, leading day-to-day execution of the AAWSAP contract.

b.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC

edges.label: Deputy Administrator running day-to-day contract execution
edges.note: Kelleher carried the NIDS field methodology into the federally funded effort and directed the biological-effects line.

edges.label: led both the NIDS and BAASS science teams on the ranch
edges.note: Sixteen years of continuous field presence across a private and then a federally funded program.
